name: FORNEXT Inc.
notes:
We operate a "Peering Proxy" service that provides a virtual peering network for our customer ASes to facilitate peering.

Unlike conventional IP transit services, our Peering Proxy is AS_PATH-transparent and advertises customer routes without prepending our own ASN (AS131948), just like an IXP Route Server.

To accept these routes, please disable first-AS validation (e.g., `enforce-first-as`) on your BGP sessions with us, as you would for an IXP Route Server.
